name: e11
description: E11 lifecycle composites: activation, issuance, retrieval, presentation and verification (plus the chain-record decoding, reported separately) through QChain's copied production code, each stage once per setting it depends on; the 16 curated suites at every N in {1,5,10,20,64} and k in {1, ceil(N/2), N}, all 176 signature x KEM pairs at N=10, k=5 (measured whole), the production suite with 256- and 4096-byte values, and the production suite chained (validation of the stage sums): 991 cells, 5 repetitions. Composites: 20 warm-up calls + 2,000 samples, or at least 60 s and 30 samples when the probe median is at least 30 ms; Go's default GC.
